description: Create a Lucie group event (a poll) for several participants, pre-filled with candidate times when everyone is free (the intersection of their availability). Returns a vote link to share: participants pick which proposed times work, and people WITHOUT a Lucie handle can vote manually too. This is a write (creates a poll) but sends no emails and touches no calendars. Confirm the title, participants, and duration with the organizer before creating. Note: agent group scheduling is a Sync Pro feature — the organizer's email must be on Sync Pro (or a Lucie Membership).

durationMinutes.description: Meeting length in minutes. Defaults to 30.

from.description: ISO-8601 start of the search window.

handles.description: Participants' @handles whose availability seeds the candidate times. The leading @ is optional.

organizerName.description: The organizer's name (shown on the poll).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the poll's displayed times, e.g. "America/New_York". Defaults to UTC.

title.description: The meeting title, e.g. "Q3 planning sync".

to.description: ISO-8601 end of the search window.

name: create_group_event
title: Create a group scheduling poll seeded with everyone's common times
